name: Business Cycle / Leading-Coincident-Lagging Indicators contract

objectSeparation.BUSINESS_CYCLE_STATE: latent/current macro state such as expansion/contraction or acceleration/deceleration; must be estimated from information available at the decision time.
objectSeparation.LEADING_INDICATOR: indicator designed to lead turning points in the reference business cycle, not necessarily stock-market returns.
objectSeparation.COINCIDENT_INDICATOR: indicator intended to move with current economic activity.
objectSeparation.LAGGING_INDICATOR: indicator intended to confirm prior/current cycle dynamics after a lag.
objectSeparation.MONITORING_SIGNAL: NDC monitoring-light composite describing current economic conditions under its own component/threshold methodology.
objectSeparation.OFFICIAL_TURNING_POINT: retrospective peak/trough chronology; ex-post benchmark unless announced in real time before the target decision.

leadingComponents: export orders diffusion index by firms
net accession rate of industry/service employees
floor area of new building starts
laggingComponents: average new-loan rate at five major banks
taiwanNDC.revisionPolicy: NDC traces and revises historical leading/coincident/lagging data monthly because new component data arrive, source agencies revise data, and seasonal/trend adjustments change.
taiwanNDC.keyGuard: Current historical series is not guaranteed to equal the value known in earlier months.

circularityFirewall.problem: TAIEX is a component of NDC leading index and monitoring indicators. Using the aggregate composite to predict TAIEX/stock returns can partially reuse the target market price.
requiredTests: aggregate NDC leading index vs ex-TAIEX reconstructed/available variant
component-only macro baseline excluding market-price component
same-period TAIEX contribution share if reconstructable
no stock-return claim unless value survives exclusion of price-derived component
circularityFirewall.defaultClassification: If ex-TAIEX value cannot be reconstructed from a valid vintage, aggregate leading/monitoring signal is descriptive cycle context only for stock-return research.

OECD_CLI.meaning: Designed to provide early qualitative signals of turning points in business cycles relative to trend/output-gap fluctuations.
OECD_CLI.guard: CLI is qualitative turning-point information, not a quantitative GDP or stock-return forecast.

NBER_DATING.meaning: Retrospective U.S. peak/trough chronology based on multiple economy-wide real-activity measures.
NBER_DATING.guard: NBER intentionally waits for sufficient evidence and revisions; the eventual recession date is an ex-post benchmark, not a contemporaneous regime label.

timeAndVintageContract.publicationGuard: Reference month and publication date are different. A July indicator published in August cannot be used as if it were known in July.
timeAndVintageContract.revisionGuard: Later revised historical values never overwrite first-known vintage in backtests.
timeAndVintageContract.turningPointGuard: Official peak/trough dates announced later cannot be backfilled into historical trading decisions.

stateMachineGuard: No cycle phase is assigned from one monthly move. Require frozen multi-month/level/slope/diffusion rules and minimum component coverage before labeling; otherwise UNKNOWN.
targetHierarchy: stock-return direction only last and only after price-component circularity is removed
falsification: aggregate leading index versus ex-TAIEX version
first-known vintage versus current revised history
one-month change versus frozen multi-month trend
NBER ex-post recession labels prohibited as live features
different Taiwan sectors with different cycle sensitivity
no turning-point threshold selected from stock returns

ownershipBoundary.D13_18: business-cycle measurement, first-known macro state, indicator vintage and turning-point uncertainty
ownershipBoundary.D18_15: strategy effectiveness conditional on an already frozen business/credit-cycle state
ownershipBoundary.D09_D07: industry/sector rotation or supply-chain response conditional on D13 cycle state; no duplicate cycle maturity

maturityDecision.reason: Leading/coincident/lagging semantics, Taiwan component structure, price-component circularity, vintage/revision rules, retrospective turning-point limits and falsification are frozen; no source-attested OOS Taiwan evidence for L3.

exactNext: Preserve an official NDC monthly business-indicator vintage with reference month/publishedAt/hash and component definitions.
Design ex-TAIEX leading/monitoring reconstruction only if component vintages make it reproducible; otherwise keep aggregate composite descriptive-only for stock studies.
Build outcome-blind cycle-state classifier from first-known vintages with UNKNOWN for insufficient history/components.
Continue D13-19 Capital Market Expectations / Long-run Growth Drivers after this module.
No Formal cycle gate before PIT/OOS incremental evidence.
